scripts.lint: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:effect && bun run lint:arch
scripts.lint:oxlint: bun run --bun oxlint --type-aware src tests scripts
scripts.lint:effect: bun run --bun effect-language-service diagnostics --project tsconfig.json --strict --format text
scripts.format: bun run --bun oxfmt --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.format:check: bun run --bun oxfmt --check src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json .dependency-cruiser.cjs
